description: Record observed results on the same run using its exact selected line IDs. Send one report for the whole shop: after every line has been tried, read the trolley once and report every line’s outcome together, with status finished in that same report when no line needs a choice. Never read the trolley or report between batches. Keep the shop open while any line needs a choice; record each choice the shopper makes here as in_trolley with its addition, even after the shop ended. in_trolley requires retailer basket confirmation. needs_choice means unresolved. To show fresh delivery windows on this card, include the observed delivery calendar and use an empty updates array if no ingredient changed. While building, process nextLineIds immediately in the same Work task. Reconcile and report finished once all lines have an outcome, or stopped when the shop cannot continue. siteChanges.layout is this supermarket’s page for the next shop: send it in this report when the supermarket has no page yet (siteGuide.pageNeeded), and again whenever a control, address or note on it turned out wrong. Record searchPath and productPath as paths on this website with {query} and {productId} marking the part that changes, only after opening a page that way; trolleyPath and favouritesPath when you saw them; and up to six short notes on what slowed you down. Pack labels in siteChanges.items are optional: Chop it saves every confirmed product itself. Only report shelf matches confirmed by that basket read. Include each observed public product pathname in the corresponding update so a repeat shop can open that same product directly. A changed layout can be reported alone. Record addition with the public productId and verified before quantity, added pack count from this shop’s action, and after quantity for each changed product. If the delta does not match, leave the addition untracked and flag the discrepancy. For needs_choice send observedPacks with actual shelf titles, pack sizes and quantities, including any pack already in the trolley that made the line unclear. Report slotHold separately, including expiry and availability of a release control. After an authorised undo send undoReadback only for verified original quantities. Never repeat a trolley action to refresh the guide.

checkedAt.description: UTC instant when Work read this retailer’s live calendar.

slots.description: Available delivery windows with the full fee quoted in the currency’s minor unit. An empty list means the checked calendar had no matching slots.

additionalFees.description: All separately quoted mandatory charges for this trolley and window, such as the small-order fee. Send [] only when verified there are none. Omit when unchecked.

finishWithChoices.description: Only when the shopper asked to finish with items still to choose.

resumeFrom.description: To continue an interrupted shop after a live trolley read, supply updatedAt from its most recent receipt. Send this alone with empty updates.

addFromResults.description: True when a pack can be added from the search results without opening the product.

favouritesPath.description: The path of the page listing what this account has bought before, when the site has one.

notes.description: Up to six short notes for the next shop here: what slowed you down and how to avoid it. Plain words, no addresses.

productPath.description: The path of a product page that opens from the product ID alone, marked {productId}. Leave out when the address needs more than the ID.

searchPath.description: The path of a search results page with the search words marked {query}, such as /search?q={query}. Only after opening one this way.

trolleyPath.description: The path of the full trolley page.

productPath.description: For a confirmed addition, copy its public product link from the shelf or trolley as a pathname only, including the SKU. Omit queries and fragments.
